name: NowItsAngeTime
source: Part of the Big Four of the MajiDou Class. A visual novel connoisseur that does monthly videos recapping news and controversies related Visual Novels. Miyako is his favorite MajiKoi and Ayumi is his favorite Tsujidou. But he stands by Mashiro from Making Lovers. And H-scenes.
translation: Part of the Big Four of the MajiDou Class. A visual novel connoisseur that does monthly videos recapping news and controversies related Visual Novels. Miyako is his favorite MajiKoi and Ayumi is his favorite Tsujidou. But he stands by Mashiro from Making Lovers. And H-scenes.
